amendment: Freeze 1.3 corrects an internal inconsistency in the v3.3 set found by the Launcher chat: frozen gtk4 4.24.1 requires glib >= 2.89 symbols, but v3.3 pinned glib2 2.88.3-1. glib2 is deliberately bumped to 2.90.1-1 together with its snapshot-paired pcre2 10.49-1 and libsysprof-capture 51.0-1 (the exact trio in the frozen sync snapshot). Also adds gtk4-layer-shell 1.3.0-1 (mux-launcher runtime). All other pins unchanged.
